title: 假日复市期指分化，油价与AI出口约束施压，算力规划和回购公告提供结构线索
title_en: Holiday-reopen futures diverge as oil and AI export controls weigh, while compute policy and buybacks offer selective support
summary: 美股感恩节休市后期指分化，道指与标普期货上涨而纳指100期货小跌；油价与AI出口约束压制科技风险偏好。广东算力与服务贸易规划、共进/通富/永兴材料回购公告提供结构线索，但A股前一交易日宽度仍弱，今日以开盘量价确认和避免追高为主。
summary_en: After the Thanksgiving cash-market holiday, futures diverged with Dow and S&P contracts higher while Nasdaq-100 futures slipped. Oil and AI export controls weigh on tech risk appetite. Guangdong compute and services-trade policy plus buybacks at Gongjin, Tongfu and Yongxing offer selective support, but weak prior A-share breadth makes opening volume confirmation and chase discipline essential.

w1-w5表示重要性，不等于涨跌幅。
重大新闻汇总
国际
中东供应风险推动布伦特升至96.57美元
胡塞武装称袭击沙特Ras Tanura炼厂，伊朗称油轮在霍尔木兹海峡附近触雷；布伦特11月26日结算涨1.2%，能源与通胀风险上升。 来源
贸易
商务部反对美国新一轮301关税措施
商务部11月26日表示，美方以“产能过剩”为由拟对包括中国在内的14个经济体加征关税，将扰乱全球供应链并推高通胀；出口链仍面临政策风险。 来源
榜单
抵押贷款金融领涨，半导体设备材料领跌
11月25日美股行业Top5为抵押贷款金融+6.86%、白银+4.96%、博彩+4.82%、医药零售+4.79%、其他贵金属+4.04%；Bottom5中半导体-1.89%、互联网零售-2.16%、半导体设备材料-2.73%。概念榜白银、体育博彩、社交媒体、SOL储备和外卖居前。 来源
政策
广东提出2028年智算规模突破1000EFlops
广东算力发展“十五五”规划提出国产算力芯片、6G协同、低轨卫星和跨境算力走廊，到2028年智算规模突破1000EFlops且新建大型数据中心PUE低于1.2。 来源
政策
八部门发布服务贸易“十五五”规划
规划部署7方面25项任务，支持数字贸易、人工智能服务贸易、绿色服务贸易及数据跨境高效便利安全流动，为软件、云服务与数字内容出海提供政策线索。 来源
政策
国内汽柴油价格每吨下调440元和425元
国家发改委明确自11月26日24时起执行；运输与消费成本边际下降，但隔夜布伦特再升意味着下一轮调价方向仍有不确定性。 来源
科技
英伟达暂停向东南亚四国发运AI服务器
据报道，先进芯片出口许可新规导致马来西亚、新加坡、泰国和印尼订单暂停交付，恢复时间未定；对服务器、数据中心与A/H算力链构成需求节奏反证。 来源
公司
共进股份拟回购1.5亿至2亿元
回购价格不超过20元/股、预计占总股本0.95%至1.27%，用于员工持股或股权激励；11月26日股价已涨停，公告后追高风险需要约束。 来源
公司
通富微电董事长提议回购1.5亿至3亿元
提议用于股权激励或员工持股计划，价格区间尚待董事会方案；11月26日收涨1.31%，但前一日跌8.46%，尚非趋势反转确认。 来源
公司
永兴材料拟回购1亿至2亿元
回购价上限50元、用于股权激励或员工持股，方案仍须股东会审议；11月26日收跌1.47%，价格反馈尚未确认公告利多。 来源
公司
叮当健康签署澳门收购谅解备忘录
拟以不低于9100万港元收购澳门目标公司全部股权及股东贷款，但正式买卖协议尚未签署；扩张逻辑与交易确定性必须分开看待。 来源

美股夜盘行情总结

夜盘指数
假日后期指呈价值强、科技弱的分化
截至11月27日08:21 CST的延迟行情，标普500期货涨0.32%、纳指100期货跌0.11%、道指期货涨0.86%；美股11月26日感恩节休市，11月27日13:00 ET提前收盘。
板块对照
行业与概念领涨未获新现金时段确认
抵押贷款金融、白银、博彩等正数Top5及半导体、半导体设备材料等Bottom5均来自11月25日现金时段；感恩节无新个股现金交易。纳指期货小跌、标普和道指期货上涨，确认价值相对韧性，但对半导体仅构成偏弱延续；代表股的新交易时段报价不可得，不默认延续。
A/H 映射
算力政策与回购支撑个股，AI链仍需量价确认
港股上一交易日宽度修复而A股仍为1766涨、3641跌；今日更可能延续结构分化。若半导体与通信板块开盘相对大盘走强并放量，政策与回购可获得确认；若纳指期货继续走弱或油价上冲，则不追高。

盘前结论

事实：美股感恩节休市，最新现金排行仍锚定11月25日；当前纳指100期货小跌而标普、道指期货上涨，科技弱于价值的分化尚未消失。

判断：广东算力规划、服务贸易规划与多家公司回购公告为国产算力、通信和个股事件提供结构性支撑，但A股前一交易日下跌家数仍显著多于上涨家数，不宜把个股催化外推为全面反转。

不确定性：油价升至96.57美元、英伟达东南亚交付暂停以及美股缩短交易日均可能放大波动；短线优先采用开盘量价与板块相对强度，而不是沿用节前榜单追涨。

重点个股关注

共进股份
603118.SH
条件关注
事实与状态：拟回购1.5亿至2亿元，按价格上限测算约占总股本0.95%至1.27%；11月26日收于13.26元、涨10.04%，利好前已强势，维持条件关注而非追涨。
确认条件：开盘不出现大幅高开回落，并在成交量支持下相对通信设备与数据中心网络板块保持强势。
风险与失效条件：回购用于激励而非直接注销，且股价已涨停；若跌破前一日强势区间或放量转弱则取消关注。 来源
通富微电
002156.SZ
条件关注
事实与状态：董事长提议回购1.5亿至3亿元，但正式方案尚待董事会；11月26日收36.48元、涨1.31%，仅部分修复前一日8.46%的跌幅。
确认条件：正式方案明确价格和数量，且开盘后相对封测、半导体设备材料板块转强并站稳前收。
风险与失效条件：美股半导体及设备材料仍属榜单弱项，回购只是提议；若板块继续领跌或股价跌破35.89元前低则失效。 来源
永兴材料
002756.SZ
条件关注
事实与状态：董事会通过1亿至2亿元回购方案、价格上限50元，但仍须股东会批准；11月26日收30.75元、跌1.47%，价格尚未确认。
确认条件：股东会通过且股价重新站上31.21元前收，并相对锂电材料或贵金属相关板块转强。
风险与失效条件：回购实施、用途和股价上限均存在不确定性；若继续弱于材料板块或跌破30.29元则取消关注。 来源
叮当健康
09886.HK
回避
事实与状态：拟以不低于9100万港元收购澳门目标公司，但目前仅签署谅解备忘录；最近可核验价格为11月25日0.82港元、跌2.37%，11月26日可靠收盘报价未取得。
确认条件：签署具法律约束力的正式协议、披露资产盈利和资金安排，并在有效交易时段出现放量正反馈后才重新评估。
风险与失效条件：交易条款未定、标的质量未知且流动性偏低；在正式协议和价格确认前维持回避。 来源

板块轮动看板

结构线索

广东算力规划、通信网络升级和服务贸易数字化利好国产算力、通信设备与软件服务，但需量价确认。

事件驱动

共进、通富、永兴材料回购公告提供个股支撑；执行条件与前期涨幅决定可交易性。

压力方向

半导体及设备材料居美股行业榜末端，英伟达交付暂停和高油价提高AI链估值与成本风险。

验证信号

观察通信、封测能否跑赢大盘，A股上涨家数能否回到下跌家数之上，以及纳指期货能否转正。

逻辑链

美股现金休市使11月25日排行只能作为历史基线，当前期指显示价值强于科技。
油价和出口管制抬升成本与不确定性，压制高估值AI和半导体风险偏好。
广东算力与服务贸易政策叠加公司回购，为国产算力、通信和事件股提供局部对冲。
因此今日更偏结构分化：先看量价和相对强度，再决定是否跟随政策与回购催化。

风险雷达

中东与油价

布伦特升至96.57美元，供应扰动若升级将重新抬高通胀和运输成本。

AI出口约束

东南亚服务器交付暂停可能拖慢数据中心投资兑现，并增加A/H供应链波动。

A股宽度

11月26日1766涨、3641跌，中位跌0.792%，大盘收平不等于个股风险消失。

假日流动性

美股缩短交易日和个股新报价缺失会放大期指与现金市场的偏差。

公告执行

回购提议、股东会审批和非约束性并购备忘录均可能低于市场预期。

数据来源与时间点

国内发现源：财联社投资日历、东方财富财经早餐、第一财经晚间公告、每经重大事件；原始/法定来源：商务部、国家发改委、广东省政务服务和数据管理局/广东省发改委发布文本、巨潮资讯/上市公司公告、HKEX；国际与行情来源：Reuters、NYSE、CME、AtlasVector。AKShare 1.18.94，2026-11-26 16:19 CST抓取；A股2026-11-26 latest_close：1766涨/3641跌/172平，中位-0.792%；港股latest_close：1099涨/856跌/847平，中位0%。美股期指为2026-11-27 08:21 CST延迟快照；个股因感恩节无新现金时段，缺失处未作延续假设。覆盖截止：2026-11-27 08:36 CST。

Major News
GLOBAL
Middle East supply risk lifts Brent to $96.57
The Houthis said they struck Saudi Arabia's Ras Tanura refinery, while Iran said tankers hit mines near the Strait of Hormuz. Brent settled 1.2% higher on Nov. 26, raising energy and inflation risk. Source
TRADE
China opposes the new U.S. Section 301 tariff measures
MOFCOM said on Nov. 26 that proposed tariffs on 14 economies, including China, would disrupt supply chains and lift inflation; export-linked sectors retain policy risk. Source
RANKING
Mortgage finance leads while semiconductor equipment and materials lag
Nov. 25 industry Top5: Mortgage Finance +6.86%, Silver +4.96%, Gambling +4.82%, Pharmaceutical Retailers +4.79%, and Other Precious Metals +4.04%. Bottom5 included Semiconductors -1.89%, Internet Retail -2.16%, and Semiconductor Equipment & Materials -2.73%. Concept leaders were Silver, Sports Betting, Social Media, SOL Reserve, and Food Delivery. Source
POLICY
Guangdong targets more than 1,000 EFlops of intelligent computing by 2028
Its 15th Five-Year compute plan covers domestic accelerators, 6G coordination, LEO satellites and cross-border compute corridors, while requiring new large data centers to keep PUE below 1.2. Source
POLICY
Eight agencies issue the 15th Five-Year services-trade plan
The plan sets 25 tasks across seven areas, supporting digital trade, AI services, green services, and efficient and secure cross-border data flows. Source
POLICY
China cuts gasoline and diesel prices by RMB440 and RMB425 per tonne
The NDRC said the adjustment took effect at midnight on Nov. 26. Transport and consumer costs ease marginally, but the renewed Brent rise clouds the next adjustment. Source
TECH
Nvidia pauses AI-server shipments to four Southeast Asian markets
New advanced-chip licensing rules reportedly halted deliveries to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand, and Indonesia with no clear restart date, adding a demand-timing counter-signal for server, data-center, and A/H compute chains. Source
COMPANY
Gongjin plans a RMB150m-200m buyback
The cap is RMB20 per share and the estimated amount equals 0.95%-1.27% of shares for employee ownership or incentives. The stock already hit its limit-up on Nov. 26, constraining chase risk. Source
COMPANY
Tongfu's chairman proposes a RMB150m-300m buyback
The proposal is for incentives or an employee plan, but pricing awaits a board-approved scheme. Shares rose 1.31% on Nov. 26 after falling 8.46% the prior day, not yet confirming a trend reversal. Source
COMPANY
Yongxing Materials proposes a RMB100m-200m buyback
The RMB50 cap and incentive/employee-plan use still require shareholder approval. Shares fell 1.47% on Nov. 26, so price action has not confirmed the announcement. Source
COMPANY
Dingdang Health signs an MOU for a Macau acquisition
It proposes at least HKD91m for all equity and shareholder loans of a Macau target, but no definitive purchase agreement has been signed; expansion logic must be separated from deal certainty. Source

US Overnight Trading Summary

FUTURES
Post-holiday futures show value strength and tech weakness
As of 08:21 CST on Nov. 27, delayed S&P 500 futures were +0.32%, Nasdaq-100 futures -0.11%, and Dow futures +0.86%. U.S. cash markets were closed for Thanksgiving on Nov. 26 and close at 1:00 p.m. ET on Nov. 27.
SECTOR CHECK
Ranking leaders lack a fresh cash-session confirmation
Positive Top5 groups such as Mortgage Finance, Silver and Gambling, and Bottom5 groups including Semiconductors and Semiconductor Equipment & Materials, all refer to the Nov. 25 cash session. Thanksgiving produced no new stock cash session. Weak Nasdaq futures versus higher S&P and Dow futures confirm value resilience and only a weak continuation for semiconductors; fresh representative-stock quotes were unavailable, so continuation is not assumed.
A/H MAP
Compute policy and buybacks support selected names, but AI needs volume confirmation
Hong Kong breadth improved in the prior session, while A shares still had 1,766 advancers versus 3,641 decliners. Today likely remains selective. Relative strength and volume in semiconductor and communications names would confirm the policy/buyback signal; continued Nasdaq-futures weakness or another oil spike would invalidate a chase.

Pre-open View

Fact: U.S. cash markets were closed for Thanksgiving and the latest cash rankings still anchor to Nov. 25; Nasdaq-100 futures now trail higher S&P and Dow futures, leaving tech weaker than value.

View: Guangdong's compute plan, the services-trade plan and several buyback announcements support domestic compute, communications and event-driven names, but the prior A-share session still had far more decliners than advancers, so stock catalysts should not be extrapolated into a broad reversal.

Uncertainty: Brent at $96.57, the Southeast Asian Nvidia-delivery pause and a shortened U.S. session may amplify volatility. Use opening volume and sector-relative strength rather than chasing holiday-stale rankings.

Stocks to Watch

Gongjin Electronics
603118.SH
Conditional Watch
Fact and state: The RMB150m-200m buyback equals an estimated 0.95%-1.27% of shares at the cap. Shares closed at RMB13.26, +10.04% on Nov. 26, so this is a watch rather than a chase.
Confirmation: Avoid a sharp gap-and-fade and maintain relative strength versus communications equipment and data-center networking peers on supportive volume.
Risk and invalidation: Shares are for incentives rather than immediate cancellation and the stock already hit limit-up; a break of the prior strong range on volume cancels the watch. Source
Tongfu Microelectronics
002156.SZ
Conditional Watch
Fact and state: The chairman proposed a RMB150m-300m buyback, but a formal board plan is pending. Shares closed at RMB36.48, +1.31% on Nov. 26, recovering only part of the prior 8.46% drop.
Confirmation: A formal plan specifies price and size, and shares outperform packaging and semiconductor-equipment peers while holding the prior close.
Risk and invalidation: U.S. semiconductors and equipment/materials remain ranking laggards and this is only a proposal; continued sector weakness or a break below RMB35.89 invalidates the watch. Source
Yongxing Materials
002756.SZ
Conditional Watch
Fact and state: The board approved a RMB100m-200m buyback capped at RMB50, but shareholder approval is still required. Shares closed at RMB30.75, -1.47% on Nov. 26, so price has not confirmed it.
Confirmation: Shareholders approve and the stock retakes the RMB31.21 prior close while outperforming lithium-material or precious-metal peers.
Risk and invalidation: Execution, use and the price cap remain uncertain; continued materials underperformance or a break below RMB30.29 cancels the watch. Source
Dingdang Health
09886.HK
Avoid
Fact and state: The proposed Macau acquisition is at least HKD91m but remains only an MOU. The latest verified quote is HKD0.82, -2.37% on Nov. 25; a reliable Nov. 26 closing quote was unavailable.
Confirmation: Reassess only after a binding agreement, target earnings and financing are disclosed, followed by positive volume response in a valid session.
Risk and invalidation: Terms are unsettled, target quality is unknown and liquidity is thin; remain in Avoid until agreement and price confirmation. Source

Sector Rotation Board

Structural support

Guangdong compute policy, communications upgrades and services-trade digitization support domestic accelerators, communications gear and software, subject to volume confirmation.

Event driven

Buybacks at Gongjin, Tongfu and Yongxing offer stock-specific support; execution conditions and prior gains determine tradability.

Pressure areas

Semiconductors and equipment/materials sit near the bottom of the U.S. industry ranking, while Nvidia shipment pauses and oil raise AI-chain risks.

Validation signals

Watch whether communications and packaging beat the market, A-share advancers overtake decliners, and Nasdaq futures turn positive.

Logic Chain

The U.S. cash-market holiday leaves Nov. 25 rankings as a historical baseline; current futures favor value over tech.
Oil and export controls raise costs and uncertainty, pressuring high-multiple AI and semiconductor risk appetite.
Guangdong compute and services-trade policy plus company buybacks provide a selective domestic hedge.
Today therefore favors dispersion: validate price, volume and relative strength before following policy or buyback catalysts.

Risk Radar

Middle East and oil

Brent at $96.57 means another supply escalation could lift inflation and logistics costs.

AI export controls

Southeast Asian server-delivery pauses may slow data-center investment and raise A/H supply-chain volatility.

A-share breadth

There were 1,766 advancers, 3,641 decliners and a -0.792% median on Nov. 26; a flat index did not remove stock-level risk.

Holiday liquidity

A shortened U.S. session and missing fresh stock quotes can widen futures-cash divergences.

Announcement execution

Buyback proposals, shareholder approvals and non-binding acquisition MOUs may underdeliver expectations.

Sources and Timestamps
